---
title: "Homogeneous vs Exact Flow"
format: html
include-after-body: leaderline-cdn.html
---

<style>
.box {
  position: absolute;
  width: 250px;
  padding: 16px;
  background-color: #f3e5f5;
  border-left: 5px solid #8e24aa;
  border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  text-align: center;
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #4a148c;
}

#eq {
  top: 80px;
  left: 420px;
  background-color: #fffde7;
  border-left-color: #f9a825;
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: 18px;
}

#check {
  top: 160px;
  left: 280px;
  width: 180px;
 background-color: #e8eaf6;
  border-left-color: #5c6bc0;
}

#not-homogeneous {
  top: 160px;
  left: 610px;
  width: 200px;
background-color: #e8eaf6;
  border-left-color: #5c6bc0;
}

#homogeneous {
  top: 260px;
  left: 240px;
  background-color: #e8eaf6;
  border-left-color: #5c6bc0;
  font-size: 14px;
}

#exact {
  top: 260px;
  left: 600px;
 background-color: #e8eaf6;
  border-left-color: #5c6bc0;
  font-size: 14px;
}

#bottom-note {
  top: 400px;
  left: 340px;
  width: 400px;
  background-color: #fce4ec;
  border-left-color: #c2185b;
  font-weight: bold;
}
</style>

<div id="eq" class="box">M(x,y)dx + N(x,y)dy = 0</div>
<div id="check" class="box">Check (Is it Homogeneous?)</div>
<div id="not-homogeneous" class="box">Only if not Homogeneous</div>
<div id="homogeneous" class="box">✅ It is Homogeneous<br>Substitute y = vx<br>Then it becomes separable</div>
<div id="exact" class="box">✅ Else it is Exact<br>If not exact, make it exact by 4 methods</div>
<div id="bottom-note" class="box">Homogeneous is a special case of Exact</div>

<script>
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('eq'),
      document.getElementById('check'),
      { color: '#888', path: 'straight', size: 2 }
    );
    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('eq'),
      document.getElementById('not-homogeneous'),
      { color: '#888', path: 'straight', size: 2 }
    );
    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('check'),
      document.getElementById('homogeneous'),
      { color: '#888', path: 'straight', size: 2 }
    );
    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('not-homogeneous'),
      document.getElementById('exact'),
      { color: '#888', path: 'straight', size: 2 }
    );
    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('homogeneous'),
      document.getElementById('bottom-note'),
      { color: '#999', path: 'arc', size: 1.5 }
    );
    new LeaderLine(
      document.getElementById('exact'),
      document.getElementById('bottom-note'),
      { color: '#999', path: 'arc', size: 1.5 }
    );
  });
</script>
